Let K=D(P_G||Q_G), O its coherent outcome KL, X=chi2(erased Q_G||erased P_G), V the exact erased score variance, beta=1-alpha, and C_V=2XV/[beta(2-beta)ln2], C_eta=2X Inf_j(G)(1-Inf_j(G))/[beta(2-beta)ln2]. Then O<=C_V<=C_eta, C_V/O~7*2^r/9, C_eta/O~10*2^r/9, C_V/K~7*2^r/(100r^2), C_eta/K~2^r/(10r^2), while O/K~9/(100r^2). Thus no absolute multiple of the SAME original KL can bound these surrogate sums over every finite prescribed physical tree, even at its first node; this does not refute existential coordinate selection, exact inherited-reference KL payment, an influence-surplus payer, or FEI.
